title: CCD: Capturing Cross-Correlations with Deformable Convolutional Networks for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting

problem.claim: Accurate multivariate time series forecasting requires capturing precise channel correlations.

gap.claim: Prior studies have primarily captured distinct channel relationships within individual frequencies and scales, while complex dependencies are more prominent across scales and frequencies.

contributions.claim: The approach represents time series as Channel-Frequency and Channel-Scale views with image-like structures and applies convolutional neural networks to capture cross-correlations.

narrative_sequence.summary: Forecasting accuracy depends on precise channel correlations.
Recent work has focused on channel relationships within individual frequencies and scales.
Complex channel dependencies are more prominent across scales and frequencies, referred to as cross-correlations.
The method uses Channel-Frequency and Channel-Scale views and convolutional neural networks to capture these dependencies.

unknowns: The abstract does not report experiments, datasets, metrics, quantitative results, or ablations.
The abstract does not explain the deformable convolutional network components named in the title.
